text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin fell before Biwa Hayahide's 
overwhelming power in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distraught over losing due to poor 
conditioning, and utterly exhausted in 
body and mind, she vents her weakness—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She asked to take a short break from both 
racing and training.
